<description>
`LogOversizedDbCache` (added in #33333) is `noexcept`, but it reads `-dbcache` through `CalculateDbCacheBytes` -> `GetIntArg`. `GetIntArg` throws when settings.json has a number that isn't an integer or doesn't fit in int64, e.g. `{"dbcache": 4096.5}`. The exception hits the `noexcept` boundary and bitcoind aborts during startup:

```
libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type std::runtime_error: JSON integer out of range
```

This removes `noexcept`. The exception now reaches the handler in `AppInit`, and the node exits with status 1 and an error message instead of aborting:

```
EXCEPTION: St13runtime_error
JSON integer out of range
bitcoin in AppInit()
```

The added case in `feature_settings.py` writes `{"dbcache": 4096.5}` to settings.json and checks that startup fails with that message from `AppInit`.
</description>
